elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解奥罗普uche热在巴西亚马逊地区的流行病学特征、临床表现和诊断方法,以应对对该新兴虫媒病毒更好地理解和管理的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了描述性和定性综合审查,搜索了 SciELO、PubMed 和 Google Scholar 数据库以及官方健康资源,重点关注 2016 年至 2026 年的研究。
elements_zh.methods: 该综述包括奥罗普切热研究的临床和流行病学数据,采用 RT-qPCR 进行初始 诊断 和 血清学 进行后续调查。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the epidemiological profile, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic approach of Oropouche fever in the Brazilian Amazon region, addressing the need for better understanding and management of this emerging arbovirus.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A descriptive and qualitative integrative review was conducted, searching SciELO, PubMed, and Google Scholar databases, and official health sources, focusing on studies from 2016 to 2026.
analysis_en.methods: The review included clinical and epidemiological data from studies on Oropouche fever, employing RT-qPCR for initial diagnosis and serology for follow-up investigations.
analysis_en.main_results: Clinical manifestations included fever, headache, myalgia, and arthralgia, often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and skin manifestations. Notable were recurrent symptoms post-improvement and less common complications like meningitis and meningoencephalitis, as well as hemorrhagic manifestations in specific cases.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the importance of recognizing clinical manifestations and interpreting diagnostic tests, contributing to better differential diagnosis, epidemiological surveillance, and timely responses in the region.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study underscores the need for enhanced surveillance and diagnostic capabilities, especially given the increasing notifications and outbreaks since late 2023, emphasizing the regional circulation of Oropouche virus.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Limitations include underreporting and variations in diagnostic coverage, which affect the reliability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate due to the nature of the review and the absence of randomized controlled trials.

title_zh: 巴西北部奥罗普uche热:流行病学特征、临床表现和诊断:一项整合性综述
source_body_en: A febre do Oropouche é uma arbovirose emergente causada pelo vírus Oropouche (OROV), do gênero Orthobunyavirus, com genoma constituído por três segmentos de RNA de polaridade negativa. Transmitida principalmente pelo maruim Culicoides paraensis, apresenta relevância epidemiológica na Região Norte do Brasil. Este estudo analisou manifestações clínicas, distribuição dos surtos e diagnóstico diferencial. Realizou-se uma revisão integrativa, descritiva e de abordagem qualitativa, com buscas nas bases SciELO, PubMed e Google Acadêmico e em fontes oficiais de saúde. Foram considerados estudos publicados entre 2016 e 2026. Os resultados apontam febre, cefaleia, mialgia e artralgia, acompanhadas eventualmente de náuseas, vômitos, tontura e manifestações cutâneas. Destacam-se a recorrência dos sintomas após melhora inicial e complicações menos usuais, como meningite e meningoencefalite, além de manifestações hemorrágicas descritas em algumas situações específicas. Esses achados merecem atenção clínica, embora não sejam exclusivos da infecção nem suficientes para diferenciá-la de outras arboviroses. A ampliação das notificações desde o final de 2023 e os surtos de 2024 reforçam a importância da circulação amazônica. A sobreposição com dengue, zika e chikungunya exige confirmação laboratorial. A RT-qPCR (reação em cadeia da polimerase com transcrição reversa em tempo real) contribui na fase inicial, enquanto a sorologia auxilia investigações posteriores, considerando janela imunológica e reatividade cruzada. A discussão evidencia limitações decorrentes da subnotificação e das diferenças na cobertura diagnóstica. Conclui-se que esta síntese contribui para reconhecer as manifestações clínicas, interpretar exames e compreender surtos regionais, subsidiando o diagnóstico diferencial, a vigilância epidemiológica e respostas oportunas em uma região com dificuldades de acesso diagnóstico.
abstract_zh: 奥罗普uche热是一种新兴的虫媒病毒病,由奥罗普uche病毒(OROV)引起,该病毒属于正 Bunyavirus 属,其基因组由三个负链 RNA 片段组成。主要通过 Culicoides paraensis 虫媒传播,在巴西北部地区具有重要的流行病学意义。本研究分析了临床表现、疫情分布和鉴别诊断。采用整合性、描述性和定性分析方法,检索了 SciELO、PubMed 和 Google 学术等数据库以及官方卫生来源。纳入了 2016 年至 2026 年间发表的研究。研究结果指出,发热、头痛、肌肉痛和关节痛是主要临床表现,偶尔伴有恶心、呕吐、头晕和皮肤表现。值得注意的是,症状在初步缓解后可能复发,且出现较少见的并发症,如脑膜炎和脑膜脑炎,以及在某些特定情况下描述的出血性表现。这些发现具有临床意义,但并非该感染的特异性表现,也不足以与其他虫媒病毒病进行鉴别。自 2023 年末以来,疫情报告数量有所增加,2024 年的疫情暴发进一步凸显了亚马逊地区病毒传播的重要性。与登革热、寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热的重叠情况需要实验室确认。RT-qPCR(实时逆转录聚合酶链反应)在早期阶段有助于诊断,而血清学方法则有助于后续调查,考虑到免疫窗口期和交叉反应性。讨论部分强调了由于报告不足和诊断覆盖率差异带来的局限性。结论认为,本综述有助于识别临床表现、解读检测结果并理解区域性疫情,从而支持鉴别诊断、流行病学监测和及时应对措施,特别是在诊断资源有限的地区。

title: Virucidal Star Polymer Disrupts Alphavirus Infection in Aedes Mosquitoes
abstract: Mosquito-borne alphaviruses represent an increasing global health threat, yet there are currently no antiviral interventions capable of targeting both the vertebrate host and mosquito vector. Here, we investigated the antiviral potential of the heparan sulfate proteoglycan-mimicking zwitterionic polymer ZP12 against alphavirus infection in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. ZP12 exhibited potent antiviral and virucidal activity against Ross River virus (RRV) and Semliki Forest virus (SFV) in C6/36 mosquito cells. Antiviral activity was retained in ex vivo mosquito gut cultures, where both high (100 μg/mL) and low (0.5 μg/mL) concentrations significantly reduced RRV replication, with viral titres reduced by up to five orders of magnitude at peak infection. Delayed-treatment studies demonstrated that ZP12 retained antiviral activity after infection had been initiated, although efficacy declined as treatment was delayed. To evaluate prophylactic delivery, mosquitoes were exposed to ZP12 through sugar feeding prior to viral challenge. While this approach did not directly protect against subsequent gut infection, follow-up experiments demonstrated that ZP12 remained biologically active within the mosquito, suggesting that limited delivery to the midgut rather than loss of antiviral activity restricted efficacy. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that ZP12 is a potent antiviral and virucidal agent against alphaviruses in mosquito cells and tissues and supports its further development as a transmission-blocking strategy for arboviral control.

title: PROPOSTA DE MODELO ESPAÇO-TEMPORAL PARA AVALIAR A ATUAÇÃO DOS AGENTES DE COMBATE ÀS ENDEMIAS SOBRE A INCIDÊNCIA DE ARBOVIROSES SOB DIFERENTES CONDIÇÕES CLIMÁTICAS
abstract: Este artigo propõe um modelo espaço-temporal para investigar a associação entre as ações dos Agentes de Combate às Endemias (ACE) e a incidência posterior de dengue, chikungunya e Zika sob diferentes condições climáticas. O desenho teórico-metodológico combina um painel territorial por semana epidemiológica, indicadores de cobertura, intensidade, continuidade e resolutividade, regressão binomial negativa com defasagens, efeitos espaço-temporais e interações com o clima. Define-se como alvo causal o efeito total da intensificação operacional sobre casos subsequentes, distinguindo-o da associação estimada sem pressupostos adicionais. Um diagrama causal explicita a resposta das equipes aos alertas e casos prévios, o papel mediador da dinâmica entomológica e as ameaças de confundimento dependente do tempo. Como demonstração, realizou-se uma simulação inteiramente sintética com 60 territórios e 6.960 observações semanais analisadas. analysis.summary_en: This study proposes a spatiotemporal model to investigate the association between the actions of Disease Control Agents (ACE) and the subsequent incidence of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika under different climatic conditions. The theoretical-methodological design combines a territorial panel by epidemiological week, coverage, intensity, continuity, and resolution indicators, negative binomial regression with lags, spatiotemporal effects, and climate interactions. The model defines the causal effect of operational intensification on subsequent cases, distinguishing it from associations estimated without additional assumptions. As a demonstration, a fully synthetic simulation with 60 territories and 6,960 weekly observations was conducted. The contemporaneous association was positive (incidence ratio of 2.79), while the lagged and adjusted specification approached the known protective effect (estimated ratio of 0.74; generated value of 0.74). The findings illustrate the potential of the model for future applications, contingent on the quality of records, causal identification, and temporal and spatial validation. However, the results are illustrative and do not represent empirical evidence on the effectiveness of ACE.

title: Global patterns of genetic diversity and evolution in chikungunya virus E2 glycoprotein
abstract: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the genetic diversity and evolution of the E2 glycoprotein in chikungunya virus (CHIKV), focusing on its role in host-cell attachment and immune recognition. Using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods, the research applies diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotype network analysis to characterize evolutionary pressures. Results show that nucleotide diversity was highest in the pre-expansion period (Pi = 0.085) and lower in recent outbreaks (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests indicated both purifying and positive selection across CHIKV lineages, with lineage-specific diversifying signals observed at key codons. These findings highlight the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein, offering insights into viral adaptation and immune evasion. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on sequence data without direct experimental validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)中E2糖蛋白的遗传多样性及进化,重点关注其在宿主细胞附着、免疫识别和谱系分化中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了来自不同地区、宿主和流行病学时期的序列数据集,以研究CHIKV E2糖蛋白的遗传结构。利用Fst进行的种群结构分析表明,不同地区的种群之间存在显著的遗传分化,反映了基因流动受限和局部化的进化轨迹。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用来自不同地区、宿主和流行病学时期的序列数据集,对E2的遗传多样性进行了全面分析。为了评估地理、宿主和时间对病毒种群结构的影响,进行了时空分层分析,利用固定指数检验(Fst)进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 核苷酸多样性在不同时期存在显著差异,其中扩张前时期(2004年前)表现出最高的多样性(Pi = 0.085),而近期的暴发时期则显示出相对较低的多样性(Pi = 0.012)。中性检验显示,在三个CHIKV E2谱系中均存在正选择和纯化选择的信号,支持了基于密码子的分析结果,即在整个E2基因中普遍存在纯化约束,但在谱系特异性位点则出现了反复的多样化信号。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了CHIKV E2糖蛋白的时空进化特性,揭示了可能影响免疫逃逸和流行病学动态的谱系特异性适应性变化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解塑造CHIKV E2糖蛋白的进化压力提供了见解,可能有助于制定监测策略、疫苗开发以及了解病毒适应性和免疫逃逸机制。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖于序列数据而没有直接的实验验证,且由于缺乏详细的统计控制和序列采样中的潜在偏差,证据强度中等。
